description:
Get the current subscription details including plan, status, billing period, and usage limits.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.
name: get_subscription

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether the subscription ends at the end of the current period; false without a subscription.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period; null without a subscription.

current_period_start.description: Start of the current billing period; null without a subscription.

plan.description: Plan to check out. `free` adds a card for pay as you go (the metered price past the included proofs); it is offered once billing is live.

scheduled_change_at.description: When the scheduled downgrade takes effect (the end of the paid period); null when nothing is scheduled.

scheduled_plan.description: The plan a scheduled downgrade moves the account to at `scheduled_change_at`; null when nothing is scheduled. Absent from an API that predates plan changes.

status.description: Stripe's status for the subscription, whatever it is (the caller decides what counts as subscribed); null when the account has no subscription.
